Addendum to the A5 open-type table 2026-11-27T08:13Z, from question-card topic #37871 (maintainer-approved 2026-11-27 08:05Z). Add one row:

| How the drawer opens | Result |
|---|---|
| A question card is pending in the last conversation, and the last close was user-initiated | **not an exception**: new conversation (`forceNew`); the old question stays in history as past (asking again is cheap) |

This keeps the A5 rule simple: only a pending write approval reopens its conversation. #37860 implements the row with the rest of the table.
